2026_03_LAC_BUF.headline: Buffalo’s injury questions sharpen the protection battle against the Chargers
2026_03_LAC_BUF.paragraph1: Buffalo enters Week 3 monitoring defensive tackle Ed Oliver and receiver DJ Moore after Moore suffered a shoulder injury, adding uncertainty to both sides of the ball. The Chargers have protection concerns of their own after reshuffling the interior line, making Buffalo’s ability to generate pressure without overcommitting important. Los Angeles needs Justin Herbert operating from manageable pockets; Buffalo needs Josh Allen to create explosives while avoiding the turnovers that can erase otherwise productive drives.
2026_03_LAC_BUF.model_rationale: Buffalo’s injury picture and Los Angeles’ interior protection make trench execution central, with both quarterbacks most dangerous when pressure does not dictate their down-to-down choices.
